module: State memory of the UI router: previous entry, current entry and pending entry, breadcrumb decorator state, and last active scope per route. It provides the accessors, the promotion of a pending entry to current entry, serialization (to survive Lua extensions reload) and reset. No navigation logic: the router decides.
notes: promotePendingEntry shifts: previous = current, current = pending, pending = nil. clearPendingEntry drops the pending entry (timeout, rejection, cancellation, preemption).

The "Compatibility shims" functions (getCurrentResolved, getCurrentRouteNode, getPendingRouteNode, getBreadcrumbs, setPendingState, promotePendingStates, setRequest) keep the return shapes of the old API; setRequest does nothing. Note: getCurrentResolved returns the full entry (currentEntry) and not its resolved part.
The decorator: {value, moduleName, visible}; visible initially equals Config.ShowContextDecoratorInBreadcrumbs.
serialize/deserialize use ResolvedRoute.toStorable/fromStorable (routeNode and functions not kept). lastActiveScopeByRoute is not serialized.

setLastActiveScope.desc: Stores a route's last active scope.

getLastActiveScope.desc: Returns the last stored active scope for the route.

clearLastActiveScope.desc: Forgets a route's last active scope (ignored if routeName is nil).

setPendingEntry.desc: Sets the navigation entry pending validation by the framework.

promotePendingEntry.desc: Promotes the pending entry to current entry (the old current becomes previous).

returns.desc: Entry {request, resolved, origin, toRoute, fromRoute, routeNode}.

getCurrentResolved.desc: Compatibility shortcut: returns the full current entry (see notes).

getCurrentRouteNode.desc: Returns the route configuration (routeNode, with its hooks) of the current entry.

getPendingRouteNode.desc: Returns the routeNode of the pending entry.

getBreadcrumbs.desc: Returns the breadcrumb of the current entry ({} if none).

setPendingState.desc: Compatibility shortcut: builds the pending entry from a routeNode and {request, resolved, origin}.

setDecorator.desc: Sets the decorator value and its module.

moduleName.desc: Owner module (first segment of the route name).

isDecoratorVisible.desc: Returns whether the decorator is visible.

clearDecorator.desc: Resets the decorator (value and module to nil, visibility to the config default).

serialize.desc: Serializes the previous/current/pending entries (storable forms) and the decorator.

deserialize.desc: Restores the state from serialize data (no effect if data is nil). Without a decorator field, the decorator is reset.

reset.desc: Resets the three entries, the last active scopes and the decorator.
